_note: World coordinates. The 640x270 core is x 0..640, y 0..270; the painted art spans x -80..720, y -96..384 (800x480). Keys 1-7 run left to right (also the arrow loop). focus = what a step-in frames (hotspots plus margin). territory = where that zone's art agent may paint (x range, plus y limits); shell, outside and centre parts are owned separately.

centre.sunbeam: floor patch from the window toward the statue and dog

layers._note: Depth bands. Objects take the band of the floor row they stand on (contact y) or the wall they hang on. Parallax px at full mouse deflection = layer index.
layers.L1: New Orleans outside: city, live oaks, power lines, streetcar
layers.L2: back wall and everything on it, floor y < 210, side-wall columns x >= 114 (left) / x <= 526 (right): bed, computer desk
layers.L3: floor contact 210 <= y < 222; side walls x 52..114 / 526..588: door and corkboard, chess table, cushion, dog
layers.L4: floor contact 222 <= y < 236; side walls x -20..52 / 588..660: fridge, statue and rug, dumbbell rack, bench
layers.L5: floor contact y >= 236; side walls x < -20 / > 660: covered bike, front floor, front cables
layers.L6: frame crops: hanging plant top-left, filing cabinet bottom-left, speaker bottom-right, cables top-right; may intrude up to 12 px into the core, never over a hotspot

skills._note: Every skill maps to exactly one hotspot object.
